Convert a logical vector or a vector of p-values or a correlation,
difference, or distance matrix into a display identifying the pairs for
which the differences were not significantly different. Designed for use
in conjunction with the output of functions like TukeyHSD, dist (stats),
simint, simtest, csimint, csimtest (multcomp), friedmanmc, kruskalmc
(pgirmess).

# Package index

## All functions

<!-- end list -->

  - `extract_p()` : Extracts p-values
  - `multcompBoxplot()` : boxplot with multcomp graphics
  - `multcompLetters()` `multcompLetters2()` `multcompLetters3()`
    `multcompLetters4()` : Letter summary of similarities and
    differences
  - `multcompTs()` : "T" depiction of undifferentiated classes
  - `plot(<multcompLetters>)` : plot multcomp graphics
  - `plot(<multcompTs>)` : plot multcomp graphics
  - `print(<multcompLetters>)` : print a multcompLetters object
  - `vec2mat()` : Convert a vector with hyphenated names into a matrix.
  - `vec2mat2()` : Convert a vector of hyphenated names into a character
    matrix.
